issues.description: Test database migrations failing with ServerError during test initialization
issues.root_cause: Migration system attempts to re-run all migrations on each test, but database state conflicts prevent successful re-application after TRUNCATE. The test harness runMigrations() function in helpers.zig is trying to idempotently apply migrations but encountering SQL constraint violations.
issues.impact: Integration tests cannot proceed because TestHarness.init() fails during migration application
notes: Database tables exist and are properly structured
2 out of 7 XC-01 tests passed (TC-XC-01-05 and TC-XC-01-06) before migration failures began
This indicates that some migrations succeed but others fail on subsequent test runs
Root cause is likely in the migration tracking or constraint handling in helpers.zig

action_items.title: Fix migration system race condition
action_items.description: The test harness runMigrations() function needs to be modified to handle already-applied migrations gracefully. The issue appears to be that migrations are re-run on each test and failing on subsequent attempts due to constraint violations or state conflicts.

action_items.title: Investigate specific migration failure
action_items.description: Enable detailed error logging in pg.zig's simpleQuery() to understand which exact SQL statement is causing 'error.ServerError'. The error occurs in readUntilReady() but the actual query is not logged.

action_items.title: Review test isolation strategy
action_items.description: Consider whether each test should run migrations at all, or whether a single setup phase should prepare the database once per test run. Current design leads to repeated migration attempts which is causing failures.

next_steps: This test run must be marked as FAILED. The BLOCKER-level database migration issue prevents any integration tests from executing. REWORK is recommended to fix the migration system before TEST-RUNNER can succeed.
